# `curb_razor_format_markup`

Experimental. With curb_razor_format_code_blocks, also re-indent markup by its nesting, as Microsoft's Razor formatter does. Only indentation changes. Read only from a section that names Razor files.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` | |
| `false` | |

**Default:** `false`

Experimental, and only on top of `curb_razor_format_code_blocks`, from a section whose glob names Razor files:

```ini
[*.{razor,cshtml}]
curb_razor_format_code_blocks = true
curb_razor_format_markup = true
```

Each markup line goes one indent in per element and code block it sits in, as Microsoft's Razor formatter puts it. Only a line's leading whitespace changes; the content of `<script>`, `<style>`, `<pre>` and `<textarea>`, comments and continued attribute lines stay as written, and a file whose tags do not balance is left alone. See [Razor](../../../workflow/razor.md).

### `curb_razor_format_markup = true`

```ini
curb_razor_format_markup = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```html
<div class="card">
<h3>@Title</h3>
@if (Items.Count > 0)
{
<ul>
@foreach (var item in Items)
{
<li>@item</li>
}
</ul>
}
</div>
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```html
<div class="card">
  <h3>@Title</h3>
  @if (Items.Count > 0)
  {
    <ul>
      @foreach (var item in Items)
      {
        <li>@item</li>
      }
    </ul>
  }
</div>
```
:::

::::
